files.caption: Two photographs of 301 The Alameda, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are dated circa 1947. The advertisement for 301 The Alameda reads: Your opportunity for gracious living in the best residential area of the city. A fine colonial home situated on nearly one acre of land surrounded by sixteen large trees. Every feature of the interior is in keeping with the stately, dignified , yet homelike atmosphere of colonial architecture. The entrance hall and reception room features a beautiful open stairway
